subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` hooks expose only `resetSession(reason?)`, or also permanently support the explicit-current-key compatibility overload from the earlier unmerged reset proposal?
rationale: This introduces a public plugin API, and the explicit-key form was not established by a shipped OpenClaw contract; maintainer intent is required before freezing that surface.

options.title: Current-session API only
options.body: Ship only `resetSession(reason?)`, keeping targeting implicit and requiring external plugins to adopt the narrow safe contract.

options.title: Support explicit-current-key calls
options.body: Document and retain both call forms as a permanent plugin compatibility commitment with focused upgrade tests.

options.title: Do not add the hook API
options.body: Require the owner plugin to use another lifecycle mechanism or wait for a separately designed generic core seam.

recommendation.title: Current-session API only
recommendation.body: Ship only `resetSession(reason?)`, keeping targeting implicit and requiring external plugins to adopt the narrow safe contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current session-reset service and plugin/core scope history make this contributor the strongest available decision owner.
